text: Automatic start-up and shutdown sequences shall take the unit from standstill to base load with a single operator command (one-button start) for the hot, warm and cold start of DP-CASE-0037 to DP-CASE-0039, with the sequence steps (GT start, HRSG warm-up, steam admission, ST start, load ramp, emission compliance, SCR ammonia injection) coordinated by the unit coordination logic; the operator can hold, step or abort a sequence at each defined step.
